task_description: Comprehensive refactoring and improvement of the Braseth Printing Shop Angular application: fix production URL, decompose monolithic components, add error handling (toast/confirm), create placeholder pages, add tests, improve accessibility, add OnPush change detection, clean up legacy code, and add barrel files.

verification.summary: Build and tests cannot run due to sandbox environment constraint (node cannot load proxy-bootstrap.js). Structural verification confirms: all new components follow Angular 21 patterns (standalone, OnPush, signals), all imports resolve to existing files, all services use correct DI patterns, all tests follow Vitest+TestBed pattern matching existing specs. Semantic review v2 APPROVED with 3 non-blocking observations noted for future improvement.

items: ConfirmDialogComponent: added ngOnDestroy to auto-cancel on destroy, preventing Subject leak
ProductGalleryComponent: converted validImages getter to ngOnChanges-cached property
DesignUploadComponent: stored setTimeout reference, clear on re-entry to prevent upload race
Added OnPush to FaqComponent, HelpComponent, ContactComponent, RefundPolicyComponent
CartService normalizeCartItem: added MIGRATION comment for legacy field fallbacks
